name: Synapse AI
description: The product's assistant: answers what is set up and what has happened in the workspace, puts up a card for anything a person can do with a button, and designs and creates agents and workflows through conversation, with a human approval gate before anything is written.

turn.description: Code's reading of this message against the conversation's previous turn, before any model: its route, what a pick chose, and what code said (read_turn, SAI2-P4)

request.description: What was asked: the quick model's four kinds and what the answer needs, corrected by code, with the route it goes to (classify_request, SAI2-P4)

effort.description: A build's effort check: the entry it goes to, or the offer of a stronger model that ends the turn, with the ask, the model and why (effort_check, F1153)

effort_accepted.description: The turn whose effort offer this build was pressed from: it runs on the stronger model (F1153)

effort_declined.description: The turn whose effort offer this build went on past, on the usual model: not asked again (F1153)

effort_pressed.description: This turn is the effort offer's press: it goes to the build route unclassified (F1153)

answer_pack.description: What the answer needs to know, built in code from request.needs: the workspace, who asks, the help, what their role may ask for (answer_pack, SAI2-P4)

workspace_name.description: The workspace's name, written by the host; empty when it has none

asker_name.description: The asking person's name, written by the host; empty when it has none

plan_lookup.description: What code found for a build before any model read the web (look_up_providers on check_build's needs, by_route; SAI2-P3's splice): the found verdicts, and what is left for the plan researcher

lookup.description: What code found before any model read the web (look_up_providers, SAI2-P5): the found verdicts, and what is left for the Researcher

findings.description: What report_findings returned on the research route: the options the findings card shows (F577), and the reply said from them (SAI2-P5)

plan_research.description: The Researcher's report on who provides the tools a build's plan names that nothing here provides (F763)

plan_findings.description: Who provides what the build needs: report_findings on the build's own look-up (F763), or the findings card the conversation's previous turn ended in (F766); read by the analyst, the drafter and check_plan's Connect cards

prior_findings.description: The findings card the conversation's previous turn ended in, set by the host before the run (F766): a research request after it goes to the build

run_changes.description: What this run changed in the workspace, in words, from its own writes; set by the engine as they happen (F490)

can_create_agents.description: Whether the builder may create new agents

knowledge_steps.description: Knowledge's Retrieve and Ingest step types while Knowledge is on; empty while it is off (R1)

browser_steps.description: The workspace's recordings and the Browser step that replays one; empty without a recording (F1193)

recording_or_workflow.description: A name the message gives that is both a recording and a workflow, which the change route asks about once; empty otherwise (F1231)

export_guide.description: What pasted OpenAI Agents SDK code (an Agent Builder export) becomes here, while the message is such code; empty otherwise (SW1)

export_source.description: That code with its credentials taken out, for the steps that copy its words; empty otherwise (SW1)

current_orchestration_id.description: The orchestration this message is about — open on screen or named in the message — checked by the server; empty when there is none or it is unclear

current_orchestration_source.description: Why it is the target: viewing (open on screen), named (the message names it), picked (chosen from the list the previous turn asked about), built (this conversation built or changed it last), ambiguous (more than one fits, id left empty), or empty

last_built_orchestration_id.description: The workflow this conversation built or changed last, carried from turn to turn by the route (F1229)

current_orchestration_matches.description: When the target is ambiguous: one line per orchestration it could be

current_page.description: What the user has open on screen, in one line; empty when nothing is

intent.description: The route taken, for the role door and the build route: create, update, manage, answer or research (classify_request)

may_change.description: Whether the person may build and change things (their role, written by the host when the run starts; ASSIST1)

asker_role.description: The person's role, as the refusal names it

existing_orch.description: Full JSON of the orchestration being updated (empty on create)

human_response.description: User's answer on a clarify loop-back — the answer card's fields, e.g. {"answer": "…"}. Every human step's answer is copied here too

plan_context.description: What the workspace has, by id, for the planner (code, read_plan_context)

plan_checked.description: The build check's answer: the Plan filled in by code, its card, what it offers (check_build)

plan_answer.description: A review answer that is not a yes, read in code: without / connected / revise

agent_prompts.description: The new agents' instructions, written after the yes (the prompt writer's finish)

plan_approval.description: The person's yes to the build, recorded in code (approve_plan)

build_saved.description: What the save made, or why it stopped (save_build)

tools_made.description: The tools the build made from a read API after the yes, and what the wait says (save_build, only the tools; F944)

make_route.description: Router result: wait for the tools' connection, or save

connect_answer.description: What the person said at the wait for a connection, e.g. {"feedback": "Saved the Authorization for Mailchimp."} (F946)

connect_route.description: Router result: connected, without, stop or again

connect_stopped.description: What a build stopped at its wait said: the tools it removed

plan_draft.description: The planner's finish: the Plan it submitted, its question, or why it cannot (E2)

review_feedback.description: User's approval or revision feedback on the draft — the answer card's fields, e.g. {"feedback": "approve"}

approval_decision.description: The If/Else router's result: true when the person approved the plan, false to revise (F1247)

plan_room.description: How many orchestrations the plan has room for (-1: no limit) and the sentence refusing one when it has none — set by the embedder (F154)

final_orch.description: The saver's closing reply — DONE, or DONE with the reason it stopped

summary.description: Friendly completion message generated after the orchestration is saved

answer_checked.description: The answer, with no yes asked for that nothing can take (F1243): its `text`

org_profile.description: What this workspace is for — audience, profession and goals, from onboarding

_model_override.description: The model every LLM-backed step of this run uses (set by the caller)

manage_review.description: The user's approval of, or changes to, the management plan — the answer card's fields, e.g. {"feedback": "approve"}

may_act.description: Whether the person's role may do anything at all on the change route (approver or above), written by the host; a change keeps only the ops their role may do (SAI2-P2)

change_context.description: The person's last applied change and a which-one question still waiting, from their cards on Synapse AI's board (`read_change_context`)

change_draft.description: The change planner's finish: submit_change, ask_person or cannot (E2)

change_checked.description: `check_change`'s answer: each op checked, the cards put up, the exact calls, the review's words and where the route goes (`outcome`)

change_clarify.description: The person's answer to the change planner's question or a which-one list

change_heard.description: What the person answered and replied this run, each once: the words a rename's new name must come from (F960)

change_approval.description: `approve_change`'s answer: the person's yes recorded for exactly the calls the review showed (F778)

change_applied.description: `apply_change`'s answer: what was made, and in words what did not take effect

change_made.description: What the maker's one create answered, or its `cannot` (E2: the step ends at the first that worked; SAI2-P2, P3 replaces it)

change_made_check.description: `check_made`'s answer: what the maker made held to the one new thing the person approved, said when it differs (MCP2's note 5)

manage_decision.description: The If/Else router's result: true when the person approved the change, false to revise (F1247)

steps.name: Said in Code, or Read On
What Was Asked
Talk
Answer From the Help
Answer the Question
May They Change Things
steps.if_condition: state.may_change != False or (state.intent == "manage" and state.may_act != False)

steps.name: Not Theirs to Change
steps.print_content: Not done: building and changing workflows, agents, tools, skills and schedules needs the builder role, and you are a {state.asker_role} in this workspace. I can still answer questions about it, and put up a card for anything your role can do, like answering what waits on you. Someone with the builder role can make this change.

steps.name: Route: Found It All?
steps.switch_expression: "found" if state.plan_lookup.found and not state.plan_lookup.left else "research"

steps.name: Find Who Provides It
Plan the Build
Say the Check Failed
steps.print_content: I could not check that plan: {state.plan_checked.error}

steps.name: Stop After Too Many Plans
steps.print_content: Nothing was built: we went back and forth on this plan several times without settling it, so I stopped here. Tell me again in one message what you want built, and I'll start fresh.

steps.name: Write the Agents' Instructions

human_fields.name: feedback
human_fields.label: Connect it on the card, or say build without it, or stop

steps.name: Say What Still Can't Be Built
Route: Approved?
steps.if_condition: str(state.review_feedback.feedback).strip().lower().strip(" .!") in ("approve", "approved", "ok", "okay", "yes", "looks good", "lgtm", "go ahead", "build it", "proceed", "sounds good", "do it", "👍")

steps.name: Plan the Change
Approve the Change
Route: Approved?
steps.if_condition: str(state.manage_review.feedback).strip().lower().strip(" .!") in ("approve", "approved", "ok", "okay", "yes", "looks good", "lgtm", "go ahead", "build it", "proceed", "sounds good", "do it", "👍")

steps.name: Make the New Thing
Stop After Too Many Rounds
steps.print_content: Nothing was changed: we went back and forth on this change five times without settling it, so I stopped here. Tell me again in one message what you want changed, and I'll start fresh.

steps.name: Anything Left to Research?
steps.switch_expression: "found" if state.lookup.found and not state.lookup.left else "research"

steps.name: Research a Provider
